hero.headline: Where Tirana opens its doors to you
hero.subtext: A renovated Albanian villa a short walk from the Old Bazaar, with home-cooked dinners, a garden to sit in, and a cobalt blue door that has welcomed travellers, neighbours and stories for decades.

story.label: Our story
story.heading: An old partisan villa, still full of life
story.paragraph1: The house is a historic Albanian villa that sheltered WWII partisans. Its bones are the same: thick walls, high ceilings, a fireplace in the common room, but the inside has been carefully renovated into a warm, social place to stay.
story.paragraph2: Local paintings hang on almost every wall, blending old and modern Albanian art, and the cobalt blue front door the hostel is named after has always meant the same thing here: peace and prosperity to whoever walks through it.
story.paragraph3: The neighbourhood is real Tirana: bakeries, corner cafes and neighbours who say hello, with Skanderbeg Square and the Old Bazaar an easy walk away.
story.door_motto: A symbol of peace and prosperity, painted cobalt blue.

amenities.label: Amenities
amenities.heading: Everything you need, nothing you don't

items.title: Free breakfast daily
items.text: Vegetarian friendly, plus Nana's traditional dinners most nights.

items.title: Towels included
items.text: No extra fees, no deposits. Just ask at reception.

items.title: Personal lockers
items.text: Spacious lockers with a key provided for every guest.

items.title: A/C + privacy curtains
items.text: Air conditioning throughout and a curtain on every bed.

items.title: Garden, terrace & bar
items.text: Where most evenings and new friendships start.

items.title: Shared kitchen
items.text: Cook your own, or join whatever's on the stove.

items.title: Free Wi-Fi
items.text: Fast enough to work, plan or upload the whole trip.

items.title: Games room
items.text: Ping pong and darts: rivalries strongly encouraged.

items.title: Bicycle parking
items.text: Safe spot for your bike; Tirana is flat and rideable.

items.title: Bag storage
items.text: Early arrival or late bus? Leave your bag with us.

items.title: Working spaces
items.text: Quiet corners and fast Wi-Fi for remote workers and planners.

items.title: Laundry service
items.text: Keep your bag light and we will sort the rest.

events.label: Events
events.heading: Something's always happening
events.description: We are not a party hostel; we are a social one. If you arrive in Tirana alone, you won't stay that way. There is something on almost every night, and it always starts the same way: someone in the common room asking if you want to join.

items.title: Karaoke nights
items.text: Nobody is good. Everybody sings.

items.title: Trivia evenings
items.text: Mixed teams: you will know half the room by round three.

items.title: Albanian Nights
items.text: Raki, folk music and stories from our staff.

items.title: Cooking classes
items.text: Learn byrek and other family favourites with Nana.

items.title: Movie nights
items.text: Projector on the terrace when the weather plays along.

items.title: BBQs
items.text: Garden grill, long tables, everyone invited.

items.title: Day trips & walking tours
items.text: Bunk'Art, Dajti Mountain and the Old Bazaar.

items.title: Stand-up comedy
items.text: Local and traveller comedians. The crowd is always mixed.

reviews.label: Reviews
reviews.heading: Guests keep saying the same things
quotes: The staff was so hospitable, and made me feel at home. The food was DELICIOUS. Honestly just eat here and you'll get the most authentic Albanian food.
Great vibe, very social hostel. Not far from the main sights. A really lovely breakfast, one of the best I had in Albania. Events every night too.
Such a warm cozy hostel. The large common area with the fireplace, the free breakfast and cheap dinners were amazing. Felt really welcome from day one.
Breakfast made by the grandma is amazing. Staff go above and beyond. I felt so relaxed in the garden, one of those places you do not want to leave.
Surrounded by authentic Albanian villas, away from the tourist bubble but still walkable to everything. The community vibe here is genuinely special.
The roof terrace at sunset, cheap dinners, friendly staff and new friends every night. Tirana is underrated and so is this place.

items.name: Mixed dorms
items.text: The social heart of the hostel, where most friendships here start.

items.name: Female-only dorms

items.name: Private rooms

features: Private space for one or two
